title: Delivery and Return-Pickup Benefit Schedule, Northgate Rewards and Northgate+
content:
The delivery figures each tier of **Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships** applies to Northgate orders, with the statuses in which they apply and the measure of a benefit's value.

| Tier | Free standard shipping on Ship to Home at or above (merchandise subtotal, USD) | Same-Day Delivery included | Same-Day fee waived at or above (USD) | Member same-day fee below that minimum (USD) | Member express fee (USD) | Free return pickup | Statuses in which benefits apply |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards | not applicable | no | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | no | active |
| Northgate+ Assist | 0.00 | yes | 35.00 | 6.99 | 10.00 | yes | trial, active, cancel pending |
| Northgate+ Student | 0.00 | yes | 35.00 | 6.99 | 10.00 | yes | trial, active, cancel pending |
| Northgate+ Monthly | 0.00 | yes | 35.00 | 6.99 | 10.00 | yes | trial, active, cancel pending |
| Northgate+ Annual | 0.00 | yes | 35.00 | 6.99 | 10.00 | yes | trial, active, cancel pending |
| Northgate+ Business | 0.00 | yes | 35.00 | 6.99 | 10.00 | yes | trial, active, cancel pending |

On every tier, delivery benefits never apply to scheduled large-item delivery or to marketplace seller-fulfilled items, and the value of one benefit use is measured as the fee avoided.

**Column meanings**

- *Free standard shipping threshold*: the merchandise subtotal at or above which a member gets free standard shipping on Ship to Home orders, in US dollars; not applicable where the tier adds no shipping benefit beyond the standard free-shipping rule of Northgate Store and Online Orders.
- *Same-Day Delivery included*: whether the tier includes free Same-Day Delivery at or above the same-day minimum.
- *Same-Day fee waived at or above*: the merchandise subtotal at or above which the Same-Day Delivery fee is waived; not applicable where same-day is not included.
- *Member same-day fee*: the reduced Same-Day Delivery fee a member pays on an order below the same-day minimum; not applicable where same-day is not included.
- *Member express fee*: the Express (within two hours) delivery fee charged to a member in place of the standard express fee; not applicable where same-day is not included.
- *Free return pickup*: whether a member may schedule a free from-home return pickup for eligible Northgate-sold items.
- *Statuses*: the membership statuses in which delivery and fuel benefits apply on the order date.
- *Fee avoided*: the value of one benefit use is the fee that would have been charged without the benefit, minus any fee actually charged.

**Threshold on both sides (hypothetical subtotals, any paid Northgate+ tier)**

| Same-day merchandise subtotal | Same-Day Delivery fee under the member benefit |
|---|---|
| 35.00 | waived |
| 34.99 | 6.99 |
